podcast.body: Released in 1995, *Bionic* was Sandbox's debut album and received a nomination for a Best New Group Award at the Junos. Its initial success led to the release of a second album, despite subsequent issues with their record company. "In 1995, they released an album entitled Bionic, which ended up being nominated for a Best New Group Award at the Junos."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the '90s: Part 1

podcast.body: This album was released in 1996. The band won three East Coast Music Awards and was nominated for a Juno before they broke up. "It was a single from a 1996 album released on network records called Bionic."
